summary: The v52 recipe enters #wizidentify, selects the carried diamond stack, and calls invent.c:fully_identify_obj(). Its makeknown expansion reaches o_init.c:discover_object() during the live moveloop. C directly invokes shk.c:gem_learned() for newly known gems, but JS requires an injected gemLearned callback and throws “discover_object requires gem_learned”. This stops replay before the later donations and prayer setup; the crowning branch is not reached by this evidence.

source.branch: o_init.c:discover_object marks a newly identified gem known and, only during the live moveloop before gameover, calls gem_learned(oindx) before update_inventory(). gem_learned walks bill-bearing shopkeepers and refreshes prices for matching unpaid gem objects. o_init.c:undiscover_object also calls it when a gem is removed from the discovery list. The JavaScript discovery function currently throws on the normal live gem-identification route unless a caller supplies a hook.
callers: wizcmds.c:wiz_identify -> invent.c:identify -> invent.c:fully_identify_obj -> hack.h:makeknown -> o_init.c:discover_object -> shk.c:gem_learned.
o_init.c:undiscover_object calls shk.c:gem_learned when a formerly named gem is forgotten.

apply.c:use_stone calls makeknown for the touchstone and selected gem; js/apply.js currently supplies note_unported("shk.c gem_learned") as an explicit fallback hook, which must be removed when wiring the implementation.
dependencies: Accepted shop delivery ea8accb036fde7b15b539cf524fac6cc53d8d4a2 supplies the already-used shk.c:get_cost / js/shk.js:get_cost behavior consumed by gem_learned; find_oid and next_shkp are also already present in js/shk.js.
No live source reservation for shk.c:gem_learned, o_init.c:discover_object, o_init.c:undiscover_object, or apply.c:use_stone was present at assignment.

evidence: Saved v52 baseline challenges/evaluations/hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json at fcfb7afe71226851b75665b753b0c2c73ceb7af4 reports the exact admitted recording 034e0fe3d8fc869b48a37c99db55c499ac8e91ddc0f8523f993fb32a6555e3dc, 738 recorded steps/screens, and stop error “discover_object requires gem_learned”. The C-first source trace reports 57 matching screens/cursors and RNG prefix before the selected inventory identification; crowning is not reached.
nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:2635-2650 defines fully_identify_obj; hack.h:1530 expands makeknown(x) to discover_object(x, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE).

nethack-c/upstream/src/o_init.c:440-494 shows observe_object and discover_object; lines 483-490 call gem_learned for a newly known GEM_CLASS object in the live moveloop before update_inventory. Lines 498-523 show undiscover_object also calls gem_learned when forgetting a gem.

nethack-c/upstream/src/shk.c:3195-3231 defines gem_learned: traverse next_shkp(fmon, TRUE), scan each bill entry, find the unpaid object by bo_id, and refresh bp->price with get_cost when its gem type matches (or all gems for STRANGE_OBJECT).
js/wizcmds.js:456-480 and js/cmd.js:3508-3515 are the live #wizidentify command path; js/invent.js:2778-2783 calls discover_object from fully_identify_obj.

js/o_init.js:428-489 currently requires a caller-provided gemLearned callback at lines 465-469 and throws on this normal call; js/o_init.js:492-525 silently skips the source gem_learned side effect in undiscover_object when no callback exists.

js/shk.js already owns get_cost, find_oid, and next_shkp; js/o_init.js already imports append_price_quote from shk.js while shk.js imports discover_object from o_init.js, so the task can wire the native helper through the existing module relationship.

js/apply.js:2287-2294 explicitly replaces the source touchstone calls’ missing default with note_unported("shk.c gem_learned"); remove this placeholder so the use_stone path reaches the same implementation.
